title: OpenWebRL: Demystifying Online Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning for Visual Web Agents
authors_zh: Rui Yang, Qianhui Wu, Yuxi Chen, Hao Bai, Wenlin Yao, Hao Cheng, Baolin Peng, Huan Zhang, Tong Zhang, Jianfeng Gao
paper_type_zh: 视觉Web智能体在线多轮强化学习框架与轨迹/任务/judge数据发布
best_for_zh: 研究Web智能体SFT、online RL、全轨迹奖励、VLM judge与live-web复现审计的读者
one_line: OpenWebRL releases 412 success-only SFT trajectories, 2,198 RL task specifications, live-browser MM-GRPO code, hybrid trajectory judging and model weights, while its roughly 54K online training rollouts and exact live-web replay remain unavailable.
OpenWebRL公开412条success-only SFT轨迹、2,198个RL task spec、hybrid trajectory reward与训练框架，但约54K online rollout未确认发布，2,102默认快照、live-web replay及Judge-13K权利仍需单独审计。
why: It makes the full causal chain from browser task and observation through actions, environment feedback, terminal judgment and policy optimization inspectable, while showing why task prompts, selected demonstrations and runtime online rollouts must be tracked as different data objects with different success balance, replay and rights risks.
inclusion_reason: OpenWebRL exposes an unusually complete environment-to-optimization boundary for visual web agents: success-only supervised trajectories, released RL task specifications, live-browser rollout code, environment feedback, hybrid trajectory reward, distilled judge data/weights, MM-GRPO scaffolding and trained policy weights. Its value for this track depends on preserving the distinction between released traces, task prompts and unreleased ephemeral online rollouts.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The canonical source is arXiv:2606.02031v2, supplemented by the official OpenWebRL project, code repository, SFT Trajectories, RL Tasks, Judge-13K, and model releases at the revisions recorded in paper.yaml. OpenWebRL addresses the systems and data problem of training visual web agents with online, multi-turn reinforcement learning against live websites rather than only cloning offline demonstrations.

The primary agent episode begins with an instruction and start URL. At each turn the policy receives the current browser screenshot, active URL, viewport, tabs, and rule-derived textual environment feedback; it emits reasoning plus one or more structured browser tool calls. The main context policy retains one current screenshot while preserving prior reasoning and environment feedback as text. An episode ends on done, step-budget exhaustion, or environment/infrastructure/generation/format failure; done alone is not proof of task success.

Three released data objects must remain separate. The SFT release contains 3,085 turn-level prompt/response examples grouped into 412 successful complete trajectories; every top-level reward is 1 and every status/terminal reason indicates successful completion, so it contains no failed demonstrations. The RL release contains 2,198 task specifications—1,464 insta-v3 and 734 pae-webvoyager—but no actions, screenshots, rewards, or terminal states. Judge-13K supplies judge train data plus a 500-example test file, while the roughly 54K online policy trajectories reported for main RL training were not confirmed as a public corpus.

OpenWebRL belongs in environment_agent_trajectory_data because it exposes task, observation, action, environment feedback, terminal status, whole-trajectory reward, and optimizer use. It is not a single homogeneous dataset: success-selected SFT turns, RL prompts, judge examples, and ephemeral online rollouts have different retention, replay, split, and rights properties. The bilingual body is written at L4 review depth while canonical metadata remains L3_summary_ready and status: partial.

本卡以arXiv:2606.02031v2为规范来源，并辅以paper.yaml所固定版本的官方OpenWebRL项目页、代码仓库、SFT Trajectories、RL Tasks、Judge-13K与模型发布。OpenWebRL处理的系统与数据问题是：如何让视觉Web智能体在live website上进行online multi-turn reinforcement learning，而不只克隆offline demonstration。

主要agent episode从instruction与start URL开始。每一turn，policy接收当前browser screenshot、active URL、viewport、tab与规则生成的文本environment feedback，并输出reasoning及一个或多个结构化browser tool call。主要context policy只保留一张当前screenshot，同时以文本保存先前reasoning与environment feedback。episode在done、step-budget耗尽或environment/infrastructure/generation/format failure时结束；仅调用done不能证明任务成功。

必须区分三类发布数据对象。SFT发布包含3,085个turn-level prompt/response example，按412条成功完整trajectory分组；所有top-level reward均为1，status与terminal reason均表示成功完成，因此没有failed demonstration。RL发布包含2,198个task specification——1,464个insta-v3与734个pae-webvoyager——但没有action、screenshot、reward或terminal state。Judge-13K提供judge train data与500-example test file，而论文报告的主要RL训练约54K条online policy trajectory尚未确认形成公开语料。

OpenWebRL归入environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为它公开task、observation、action、environment feedback、terminal status、whole-trajectory reward与optimizer use。它不是单一同质数据集：success-selected SFT turn、RL prompt、judge example与临时online rollout具有不同retention、replay、split与rights性质。双语正文达到待人工审核的L4深度，canonical metadata保持L3_summary_ready与status: partial。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
OpenWebRL's core contribution is a live-browser environment-to-optimization loop: filter web tasks, collect success-filtered teacher trajectories for SFT, warm-start a visual policy, generate grouped online trajectories from the current policy, score complete interactions with a hybrid reward, and update with multimodal multi-turn GRPO. This couples the data object to both the mutable web environment and the verifier used during optimization.

The browser interface exposes 13 tools for click, hover, drag, write, key presses, scroll, navigation, wait, tab operations, and done. Each action returns rule-derived textual feedback from URL/tab/scroll/focus/element changes and exceptions. That feedback describes environment transition but is not an expert process label or dense learned reward.

The reward contract is mixed. Deterministic rules parse response format and check status; a binary VLM judge evaluates valid completed trajectories using the task, final answer, three recent screenshots, tool/action history, and environment feedback. A trajectory receives positive reward only when it is format-valid and judged successful; malformed format is penalized, while other incomplete/non-success cases receive zero. Judge timeout or infrastructure failure can be loss-masked, so they are not equivalent to negative policy examples.

Relative to offline web-agent imitation, the key change is current-policy data generation and full-trajectory reward inside isolated live-browser sandboxes. Relative to simple terminal exact-match verification, OpenWebRL combines format rules with semantic VLM judgment and preserves environment feedback. The judge remains fallible: the paper reports that a naive base-VLM judge yields high training reward while evaluation collapses, whereas the distilled judge tracks GPT-4.1 more closely.

OpenWebRL的核心贡献是live-browser environment-to-optimization loop：过滤Web task，收集success-filtered teacher trajectory用于SFT，以其warm-start视觉policy，从当前policy生成grouped online trajectory，用hybrid reward评分完整交互，再通过multimodal multi-turn GRPO更新。这把data object同时绑定到可变Web环境与优化期间使用的verifier。

browser接口提供13种工具，覆盖click、hover、drag、write、key press、scroll、navigation、wait、tab operation与done。每个action根据URL/tab/scroll/focus/element变化和exception返回规则生成的文本反馈。该反馈描述environment transition，但不是expert process label或dense learned reward。

reward契约是mixed。deterministic rule解析response format并检查status；binary VLM judge用task、final answer、最近三张screenshot、tool/action history与environment feedback评估合法且完成的trajectory。只有format-valid且被判成功的trajectory获得正reward；malformed format受惩罚，其他不完整/未成功情况为0。judge timeout或infrastructure failure可被loss-mask，因此不等同于负policy example。

相对offline web-agent imitation，关键变化是在隔离live-browser sandbox中进行current-policy data generation与full-trajectory reward。相对简单terminal exact-match verification，OpenWebRL组合format rule与semantic VLM judgment，并保留environment feedback。judge仍可能失效：论文报告naive base-VLM judge会产生高training reward但evaluation崩塌，而distilled judge更接近GPT-4.1。

title: Method
方法
html:
Task filtering and SFT collection. The paper starts from 292K WebGym tasks and removes evaluation overlap, decomposed subtasks, unstable/long-tail sites, and semantic near duplicates, yielding 15,601 SFT-candidate tasks and roughly 2.2K RL tasks. Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking samples four live-browser trajectories per SFT seed; GPT-4.1 judges completion. Default selection keeps the shortest successful PAE-WebVoyager trajectory per task group, breaks ties by shorter response length, and caps tasks per website, producing 412 successful trajectories across 70 websites. The official SFT release expands these into 3,085 turn-level rows and publishes no failed demonstrations.

SFT and online RL. The reported main system uses Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking. A three-epoch LLaMAFactory SFT warm start is followed by multimodal multi-turn GRPO. Online sampling draws groups of five current-policy trajectories per RL task, dynamically collects 48 effective groups per iteration, and discards groups with identical rewards. The rollout curriculum uses 15 steps followed by 30 steps; Appendix Table 7 reports sampling temperature 0.8, maximum response length 1,024, and context length 32,768. The paper reports about 90 iterations, 300 B200 GPU-hours, 80–100 concurrent sandboxes, and approximately 54K online trajectories.

Environment lifecycle. Playwright/Chromium interacts with live websites. Paper training assigns each rollout a separate Kubernetes/Orchard browser server to reduce stale cookies, crashes, leaks, and cross-trajectory side effects; public code also supports local-process and Browser-Use-hosted modes. Episodes end on done, budget, or failures. Exact browser image, site state, time, locale, region, cookies, personalization, CAPTCHA/anti-bot state, dependencies, and paid Browser-Use settings for paper runs are not pinned in one replay manifest.

Reward and judge construction. Format/status checks gate a GPT-4.1 binary full-trajectory judge. Invalid format is penalized; non-success/incomplete results are zero; judge or infrastructure failures may be loss-masked. An 8B judge is distilled from 12.5K diverse online rollouts labeled by GPT-4.1. Judge-13K exposes train data and a 500-example test file, but its complete indexed count, class balance, privacy audit, and license are unknown. Dynamic masking/filtering means generated rollout count differs from optimizer-consumed examples.

Released RL tasks and reproduction boundary. The official JSONL has 2,198 tasks: 1,464 insta-v3 plus 734 pae-webvoyager. The repository's default launcher instead uses a filtered 2,102-task parquet snapshot. Exact paper-run membership therefore requires a pinned manifest. Reproduction should also fix code commit, containers, browser/model/API versions, seeds, task/filter hashes, reward constants/config, judge checkpoint, optimizer launch, site/session state, and retention/masking ledger; the roughly 54K rollout corpus and full paper-run manifest were not confirmed public.

任务过滤与SFT收集。 论文从292K个WebGym task开始，移除evaluation overlap、decomposed subtask、不稳定/long-tail site与semantic near duplicate，得到15,601个SFT-candidate task和约2.2K个RL task。Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking为每个SFT seed采样四条live-browser trajectory，由GPT-4.1判断completion。默认selection保留每个task group中最短的成功PAE-WebVoyager trajectory，以更短response length打破平局，并限制每个website的task数，最终得到70个website上的412条成功trajectory。官方SFT发布将其展开为3,085个turn-level row，不发布failed demonstration。

SFT与online RL。 报告的主要系统使用Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking。先进行三个epoch的LLaMAFactory SFT warm start，再执行multimodal multi-turn GRPO。online sampling对每个RL task从当前policy抽取五条trajectory为一组，每次iteration动态收集48个effective group，并丢弃reward完全相同的group。rollout curriculum先15步后30步；附录表7报告sampling temperature 0.8、maximum response length 1,024与context length 32,768。论文报告约90个iteration、300 B200 GPU-hours、80–100个concurrent sandbox与约54K条online trajectory。

环境生命周期。 Playwright/Chromium与live website交互。论文训练为每条rollout分配独立Kubernetes/Orchard browser server，以减少stale cookie、crash、leak和跨trajectory side effect；公开代码还支持local-process与Browser-Use-hosted模式。episode在done、budget或failure时结束。论文运行的精确browser image、site state、time、locale、region、cookie、personalization、CAPTCHA/anti-bot状态、dependency与付费Browser-Use设置未固定在统一replay manifest中。

reward与judge构造。 format/status check作为GPT-4.1 binary full-trajectory judge的gate。invalid format受惩罚，未成功/不完整结果为0，judge或infrastructure failure可被loss-mask。8B judge由12.5K条多样online rollout及GPT-4.1 label蒸馏。Judge-13K公开train data与500-example test file，但完整indexed count、class balance、privacy audit与license均为unknown。dynamic masking/filtering意味着生成rollout数不等于optimizer实际消费example数。

发布RL task与复现边界。 官方JSONL有2,198个task：1,464个insta-v3加734个pae-webvoyager。仓库默认launcher却使用过滤后的2,102-task parquet snapshot。精确paper-run membership因此需要固定manifest。复现还应固定code commit、container、browser/model/API版本、seed、task/filter hash、reward constant/config、judge checkpoint、optimizer launch、site/session状态与retention/masking ledger；约54K rollout corpus及完整paper-run manifest尚未确认公开。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
All benchmark and judge results are author-reported and were not independently reproduced. At a 30-step evaluation budget, Table 2 reports OpenWebRL-4B success of 74.1% on WebVoyager, 67.0% on Online-Mind2Web, and 64.0% on DeepShop. These values depend on live-site state, Browser-Use Stealth Browser service, model/judge versions, retry/abort handling, and the paper's metric definition. Success excluding aborted non-agent failures is a separate statistic and must not be merged with official-score success.

Judge evaluation on the held-out 500-rollout file reports 89.8% accuracy and 92.1% F1 against GPT-4.1 labels. This measures agreement with a proprietary teacher, not human-verified ground-truth success. The judge ablation is more diagnostic: using a naive base VLM as judge produces high training reward while downstream evaluation collapses, whereas the distilled judge tracks GPT-4.1 more closely. The result demonstrates reward-hacking risk and the importance of judge construction; it does not certify the distilled judge as error-free.

Public artifact statistics are stronger evidence about the released data objects. The SFT dataset has 3,085 turn rows from 412 trajectories/tasks, all with reward 1, status completed, and terminal reason task_completed; failed demonstrations are absent. The RL-task JSONL has 2,198 specifications, but the default code snapshot trains from 2,102 tasks. Judge-13K exposes train and 500-example test files, yet lacks a public dataset card/license and was only partially indexed during audit.

The paper reports approximately 54K online trajectories for the main RL run, but official releases were found only for success-only SFT trajectories, RL prompts, judge data/weights, code, and policy/SFT/judge weights. No canonical full 54K rollout manifest with success, failure, abort, reward, mask, optimizer step, and checkpoint linkage was confirmed. Runtime generation is therefore paper evidence, not a released rollout-corpus claim.

The paper manually audits 100 failed Online-Mind2Web evaluation trajectories without the Stealth Browser service: 51% access/environment, 27% reasoning/knowledge, 13% visual grounding/interaction, and 9% task definition/judge issues. This identifies concrete failure categories, but the 100 record-level traces were not confirmed public and the sample condition differs from official hosted-browser evaluation.

以下benchmark与judge结果均为作者报告，尚未独立复现。在30步evaluation budget下，表2报告OpenWebRL-4B success为：WebVoyager 74.1%、Online-Mind2Web 67.0%、DeepShop 64.0%。这些值依赖live-site状态、Browser-Use Stealth Browser服务、model/judge版本、retry/abort处理与论文metric定义。排除aborted non-agent failure后的success是另一统计，不能与official-score success合并。

judge在held-out 500-rollout文件上的评测报告：相对GPT-4.1 label，accuracy 89.8%、F1 92.1%。这测量与proprietary teacher的一致性，而非human-verified ground-truth success。judge ablation更具诊断性：用naive base VLM作judge时training reward很高，但downstream evaluation崩塌；distilled judge则更接近GPT-4.1。该结果展示reward-hacking风险及judge构造的重要性，但不能认证distilled judge无错误。

公开artifact统计对已发布数据对象提供更强证据。SFT dataset包含来自412条trajectory/task的3,085个turn row，全部reward为1、status为completed、terminal reason为task_completed；failed demonstration缺失。RL-task JSONL有2,198个specification，但默认代码snapshot从2,102个task训练。Judge-13K公开train与500-example test file，却缺少公开dataset card/license，审计时也只有部分index。

论文报告主要RL run约生成54K条online trajectory，但已找到的官方发布仅包括success-only SFT trajectory、RL prompt、judge data/weight、代码与policy/SFT/judge weight。未确认包含success、failure、abort、reward、mask、optimizer step与checkpoint链接的规范化完整54K rollout manifest。因此runtime generation属于论文证据，不是已发布rollout-corpus声称。

论文人工审计100条未使用Stealth Browser服务的Online-Mind2Web失败evaluation trajectory：51%为access/environment、27%为reasoning/knowledge、13%为visual grounding/interaction、9%为task definition/judge issue。这给出具体failure category，但100条record-level trace未确认公开，且抽样条件不同于official hosted-browser evaluation。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is offline web-agent imitation: select completed browser demonstrations and train assistant turns without collecting current-policy interaction. OpenWebRL extends this into a live environment-to-optimization pipeline in which the policy generates new multi-turn trajectories, whole-trajectory hybrid rewards determine group-relative advantages, and MM-GRPO updates the same policy. The important new data object is the optimizer-linked online episode, even though the full reported 54K set is not released.

A second change is the explicit separation between environment feedback and reward. Browser rules return textual state-change diagnostics after actions; deterministic format/status checks gate a semantic VLM judge that scores the full trajectory. This makes feedback inspectable at two layers and supports judge distillation, while also exposing how formatting, infrastructure masking, identical-reward group dropping, and teacher-judge errors alter which rollouts train the policy.

The release itself is unusually multi-part: success-only SFT turn rows, RL task specifications, Judge-13K, judge/policy weights, and browser/optimizer code. Treating these as one “trajectory dataset” would hide crucial differences. The 3,085 SFT rows must be grouped into 412 trajectories; the 2,198 RL rows are prompts rather than demonstrations; the 2,102 default snapshot is a different membership set; and the approximately 54K online rollouts remain runtime data.

The work does not newly introduce browser tools, ReAct, SFT, PPO/GRPO, Kubernetes isolation, VLM judges, or success filtering individually. Performance breadth and GPU scale are not record-quality proof. Reuse still requires a paper-bound run manifest, release/masking ledger, judge error audit, exact decontamination report, live-site replay strategy, privacy/copyright review, and explicit Judge-13K/model/site-content rights.

最接近的baseline是offline web-agent imitation：选择已完成browser demonstration并训练assistant turn，不收集current-policy interaction。OpenWebRL把它扩展为live environment-to-optimization pipeline：policy生成新的multi-turn trajectory，whole-trajectory hybrid reward决定group-relative advantage，MM-GRPO更新同一policy。关键新数据对象是与optimizer链接的online episode，尽管报告的完整54K集合并未发布。

第二项变化是明确分开environment feedback与reward。browser rule在action后返回文本state-change diagnostic；deterministic format/status check作为semantic VLM judge评估完整trajectory的gate。这让两层反馈可检查并支持judge distillation，也暴露formatting、infrastructure masking、丢弃identical-reward group及teacher-judge error如何改变进入训练的rollout。

发布本身由多种对象组成：success-only SFT turn row、RL task specification、Judge-13K、judge/policy weight与browser/optimizer代码。把它们统称为一个“trajectory dataset”会隐藏关键差别。3,085个SFT row必须按412条trajectory分组；2,198个RL row是prompt而非demonstration；2,102个默认snapshot使用不同membership；约54K条online rollout仍是runtime data。

本文并未分别新提出browser tool、ReAct、SFT、PPO/GRPO、Kubernetes isolation、VLM judge或success filtering。performance breadth与GPU规模不是逐记录质量证明。复用仍需paper-bound run manifest、release/masking ledger、judge error audit、精确decontamination report、live-site replay策略、privacy/copyright review及明确的Judge-13K/model/site-content权利。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Success-only SFT: All 3,085 public turn rows come from 412 successful completed trajectories with reward 1. Failed demonstrations and recovery behavior are absent; treating rows independently can also obscure trajectory boundaries and duplicate history context.
  • Online rollout release gap: The approximately 54K main-policy trajectories are not confirmed public. Identical-reward groups are discarded, judge/infrastructure failures can be loss-masked, and no immutable ledger connects generated episodes to rewards, masks, optimizer steps, or checkpoints. Full success/failure/abort retention is unknown.
  • Task membership drift: The public RL JSONL contains 2,198 tasks, whereas default code uses a 2,102-task parquet. A paper-bound manifest is needed to know which tasks, filters, evaluator references, and validation rows produced the reported model.
  • Judge validity: The VLM judge can be gamed and is trained against GPT-4.1 labels rather than independent human truth. Format gating, parsing, screenshots limited to the recent three, action/history truncation, API drift, and failure masking can create false positives or negatives. Judge-13K class balance and full indexed count are unknown.
  • Live-web replay: Website content, availability, locale, region, time, cookies, personalization, login state, CAPTCHA/anti-bot behavior, redirects, and paid Browser-Use service behavior change observations and outcomes. Kubernetes isolation reduces cross-rollout contamination but does not provide deterministic site snapshots or replay capsules.
  • Decontamination and lineage: Evaluation-overlap filtering and embedding deduplication are reported, but no immutable task-level overlap hashes, rejection ledger, exact benchmark snapshots, or base-model pretraining exposure audit is released. The full chain from 292K source tasks to 15,601 SFT candidates, 412 traces, 2,198/2,102 RL tasks, and online rollouts is incomplete.
  • Licensing: Code, SFT Trajectories, and RL Tasks specify Apache-2.0. Judge-13K and individual policy/SFT/judge model APIs expose no confirmed license/model-card metadata. Website content, screenshots, upstream benchmarks, and third-party services may carry separate rights; they cannot inherit Apache-2.0 by assumption.
  • Privacy and safety: SFT records contain screenshots, URLs, histories, and responses from live sites. Cards say private data is not intended, but no systematic PII/copyright scan, redaction, consent, data-subject, or takedown audit is documented. Risks include scraping, bot-detection bypass, inauthentic engagement, purchases/forms errors, and traffic imposed on third parties.
  • Systems and metrics: Official scoring depends on a paid Stealth Browser service and recommended judges. Success excluding aborted infrastructure failures is a distinct metric. Exact code/container/browser/model/API pins, seeds, dependencies, reward constants, and a normalized 90-iteration/30-step-stage launch manifest are unavailable.

• success-only SFT： 公开3,085个turn row全部来自412条成功完成trajectory，reward均为1。failed demonstration与recovery behavior缺失；独立使用row还可能掩盖trajectory boundary并重复history context。
  • online rollout发布缺口： 主要policy约54K条trajectory未确认公开。identical-reward group被丢弃，judge/infrastructure failure可被loss-mask，也没有不可变ledger把生成episode连接到reward、mask、optimizer step或checkpoint。完整success/failure/abort retention为unknown。
  • task membership漂移： 公开RL JSONL含2,198个task，默认代码使用2,102-task parquet。需要paper-bound manifest才能确定哪些task、filter、evaluator reference与validation row产生报告模型。
  • judge有效性： VLM judge可能被gaming，且以GPT-4.1 label而非独立human truth训练。format gating、parsing、仅最近三张screenshot、action/history截断、API漂移与failure masking可能产生false positive/negative。Judge-13K class balance与完整indexed count为unknown。
  • live-web replay： website content、availability、locale、region、time、cookie、personalization、login state、CAPTCHA/anti-bot behavior、redirect与付费Browser-Use服务行为都会改变observation和outcome。Kubernetes isolation减少跨rollout污染，但不提供deterministic site snapshot或replay capsule。
  • decontamination与lineage： 论文报告evaluation-overlap filtering和embedding deduplication，但未发布不可变task-level overlap hash、rejection ledger、精确benchmark snapshot或base-model pretraining exposure audit。从292K source task到15,601个SFT candidate、412条trace、2,198/2,102个RL task与online rollout的完整链仍不完整。
  • 许可： code、SFT Trajectories与RL Tasks声明Apache-2.0。Judge-13K及各policy/SFT/judge model API没有已确认license/model-card metadata。website content、screenshot、upstream benchmark与third-party service可能适用单独权利，不能假设继承Apache-2.0。
  • 隐私与安全： SFT记录包含来自live site的screenshot、URL、history与response。dataset card称无意包含private data，但未记录系统化PII/copyright scan、redaction、consent、data-subject或takedown audit。风险包括scraping、绕过bot detection、inauthentic engagement、purchase/form错误及对第三方施加流量。
  • 系统与metric： official scoring依赖付费Stealth Browser服务与推荐judge。排除aborted infrastructure failure的success是不同metric。精确code/container/browser/model/API固定、seed、dependency、reward constant及规范化90-iteration/30-step-stage launch manifest均不可用。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, OpenWebRL is a concrete schema for separating four layers: task specifications, selected SFT episodes, runtime online rollouts, and judge examples. A reusable episode record should preserve task/source/filter hashes, site/session state, screenshot and text-history policy, tool calls and environment feedback, terminal reason, format/judge/combined reward, timeout/infrastructure status, loss mask, group membership, optimizer step, checkpoint, and all model/judge/config revisions.

For SFT, the public 3,085 turn rows can train browser reasoning/tool-call formatting when grouped back into 412 trajectories. Their success-only construction is appropriate for imitation but unsuitable for studying failed recovery without additional negative episodes. Users should retain rollout_idx, turn index, last-turn flag, screenshot, messages, total steps, and reward metadata rather than treating each row as an independent trajectory.

For distillation and reward modeling, Judge-13K plus the released judge weights provide a starting point for reproducing a trajectory-success classifier and comparing it with GPT-4.1. Reuse requires verifying the actual train count, 500-example test split, class balance, schema, privacy, model cards, and licenses. Agreement with GPT-4.1 should be reported separately from human correctness and reward-hacking robustness.

For RLVR and agent training, the released tasks, browser harness, hybrid reward, MM-GRPO launcher, sandbox isolation, and policy weights form an executable recipe. Reproduction must choose explicitly between the 2,198-task release and 2,102-task default snapshot, pin judge and environment state, preserve loss-masked infrastructure failures, and record every generated rollout. The paper's approximately 54K trajectories cannot be reused as data until they are actually released with lineage.

For evaluation, WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and DeepShop results can be reproduced only approximately on live sites. Report official success and success excluding aborted non-agent failures separately, and record site/date/region/cookie/CAPTCHA state, browser service, judge, and step budget. Current supported uses are exactly SFT, distillation, reward modeling, RLVR, agent training, and evaluation; preference learning, process supervision, offline RL, or safety-alignment data are not evidenced.

对environment_agent_trajectory_data而言，OpenWebRL提供了区分四层对象的具体schema：task specification、selected SFT episode、runtime online rollout与judge example。可复用episode record应保留task/source/filter hash、site/session状态、screenshot与text-history policy、tool call与environment feedback、terminal reason、format/judge/combined reward、timeout/infrastructure status、loss mask、group membership、optimizer step、checkpoint及全部model/judge/config revision。

用于SFT时，公开3,085个turn row在重新按412条trajectory分组后，可训练browser reasoning/tool-call format。其success-only构造适合imitation，但没有额外negative episode时不适合研究failed recovery。使用者应保留rollout_idx、turn index、last-turn flag、screenshot、message、total step与reward metadata，不能把每个row视为独立trajectory。

用于distillation与reward modeling时，Judge-13K和发布的judge weight可作为复现trajectory-success classifier并与GPT-4.1比较的起点。复用前需核验实际train count、500-example test split、class balance、schema、privacy、model card与license。与GPT-4.1的一致性应和human correctness、reward-hacking robustness分别报告。

用于RLVR与agent training时，发布task、browser harness、hybrid reward、MM-GRPO launcher、sandbox isolation与policy weight构成可执行recipe。复现必须明确选择2,198-task release还是2,102-task默认snapshot，固定judge与environment state，保留被loss-mask的infrastructure failure，并记录每条生成rollout。论文约54K条trajectory在带lineage实际发布前不能作为数据复用。

用于evaluation时，WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web与DeepShop结果在live site上只能近似复现。应分别报告official success与排除aborted non-agent failure的success，并记录site/date/region/cookie/CAPTCHA状态、browser service、judge与step budget。当前支持用途严格为SFT、distillation、reward modeling、RLVR、agent training与evaluation；没有证据支持preference learning、process supervision、offline RL或safety-alignment data。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the public SFT unit straight: 3,085 turn-level examples = 412 successful complete trajectories; every top-level reward is 1 and failed demonstrations are absent.
  • Keep RL tasks separate from rollouts: the official JSONL has 2,198 tasks, while default code uses a 2,102-task parquet; neither file contains policy trajectories.
  • The paper reports approximately 54K online RL trajectories, but no canonical public corpus or complete success/failure/abort/mask manifest was confirmed.
  • Read reward code with §4.3: deterministic format/status rules gate a full-trajectory VLM judge, and judge/infrastructure failures can be loss-masked rather than treated as negative policy examples.
  • Judge-13K has train and 500-example test files, but its full count, class balance, privacy audit, and license are unknown; Apache-2.0 applies only to confirmed code/SFT/RL-task artifacts.
  • Live websites and paid browser infrastructure make exact replay unavailable; pin site/date/region/cookies, browser image/service, judge, step budget, reward config, seeds, and masking before comparison.

• 明确公开SFT单元：3,085个turn-level example = 412条成功完整trajectory；所有top-level reward均为1，failed demonstration缺失。
  • 区分RL task与rollout：官方JSONL有2,198个task，默认代码使用2,102-task parquet；两个文件都不包含policy trajectory。
  • 论文报告约54K条online RL trajectory，但尚未确认规范化公开语料或完整success/failure/abort/mask manifest。
  • 结合§4.3阅读reward代码：deterministic format/status rule作为full-trajectory VLM judge的gate，judge/infrastructure failure可被loss-mask，而非当作负policy example。
  • Judge-13K有train与500-example test file，但full count、class balance、privacy audit与license为unknown；Apache-2.0只适用于已确认的code/SFT/RL-task artifact。
  • live website与付费browser基础设施使精确replay不可用；比较前应固定site/date/region/cookie、browser image/service、judge、step budget、reward config、seed与masking。

value.html: WebGym supplies the starting task pool. The paper reports filtering 292K raw tasks by evaluation overlap, decomposed-subtask status, website stability/popularity, and semantic near-duplication, producing 15,601 SFT-candidate tasks and roughly 2.2K RL tasks. The official RL-task JSONL contains 2,198 records: 1,464 insta-v3 and 734 pae-webvoyager; the repository's default training parquet contains a further filtered 2,102-task snapshot.

value_zh.html: WebGym 提供起始任务池。论文报告按评测重叠、分解子任务状态、网站稳定性/流行度与语义近重复过滤 292K 条原始任务，产生 15,601 个 SFT 候选任务与约 2.2K 个 RL 任务。官方 RL 任务 JSONL 含 2,198 条记录：1,464 条 insta-v3 与 734 条 pae-webvoyager；仓库默认训练 parquet 含进一步过滤的 2,102 任务快照。

value.html: Current browser screenshot plus active URL, viewport, tabs, and rule-derived textual environment feedback. The main context policy keeps one current screenshot while retaining prior assistant reasoning and environment feedback as textual history.

value_zh.html: 当前浏览器截图外加活动 URL、视口、标签页与规则派生的文本环境反馈。主上下文策略保留一张当前截图，同时将先前助手推理与环境反馈保留为文本历史。

value.html: The public SFT object is 3,085 turn-level prompt/response examples derived from 412 successful complete trajectories. A policy turn contains a <think> block followed by one or more structured <tool_call> blocks; the final done call emits a plain-text response. RL-task records are task specifications, not trajectories.

value_zh.html: 公开 SFT 对象是源自 412 条成功完整轨迹的 3,085 条轮次级提示/回复样例。一个策略轮次含一个 <think> 块，随后一个或多个结构化 <tool_call> 块；最终 done 调用发出纯文本回复。RL 任务记录是任务规格，不是轨迹。

value.html: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking generates four teacher trajectories per filtered SFT seed task; GPT-4.1 judges completion and the shortest successful trajectory is selected. During MM-GRPO, the current OpenWebRL policy generates approximately 54K online browser trajectories, but a canonical public corpus of those RL rollouts was not confirmed.

value_zh.html: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking 为每个过滤后的 SFT 种子任务生成四条教师轨迹；GPT-4.1 判定完成并选取最短成功轨迹。MM-GRPO 期间，当前 OpenWebRL 策略生成约 54K 条在线浏览器轨迹，但未确认这些 RL rollout 的规范公开语料。

value.html: Playwright with Chromium on live websites. Paper training uses isolated per-rollout Kubernetes/Orchard sandboxes; the public framework also supports local-process and Browser-Use-hosted browser modes. Each task supplies an instruction and start URL.

value_zh.html: 在实时网站上用 Playwright 与 Chromium。论文训练使用隔离的逐 rollout Kubernetes/Orchard 沙箱；公开框架也支持本地进程与 Browser-Use 托管的浏览器模式。每个任务提供一条指令与起始 URL。

value.html: A hybrid trajectory-level contract gates a binary VLM judge with deterministic response-format and status checks. Completed valid episodes are judged from the task, final answer, three recent screenshots, tool-call history, and environment feedback. Malformed-format termination is penalized; other incomplete trajectories receive zero; judge/infrastructure failures can be loss-masked.

value_zh.html: 混合轨迹级契约用确定性回复格式与状态检查门控二元 VLM 评审。已完成的有效 episode 根据任务、最终答案、三张最近截图、工具调用历史与环境反馈判定。格式畸形终止被惩罚；其他不完整轨迹得零；评审/基础设施失败可被损失掩盖。

value.html: An episode terminates when the agent calls done, reaches the step budget, or an environment/infrastructure/generation/format failure occurs. Calling done is not sufficient for success: the extracted answer and trajectory evidence must receive a SUCCESS verdict after rule checks.

value_zh.html: 当智能体调用 done、达到步数预算，或发生环境/基础设施/生成/格式失败时，episode 终止。调用 done 不足以构成成功：提取的答案与轨迹证据必须在规则检查后获得 SUCCESS 裁决。

value.html: WebGym task pool -> overlap/stability/subtask/dedup filtering -> teacher live-browser rollouts -> GPT-4.1 success judgment -> shortest-success SFT curation -> SFT warm start -> current-policy grouped live-browser rollouts -> format and VLM-judge reward -> MM-GRPO updates. Public record-level lineage is strongest for the SFT turns and RL prompts; the complete main-run online rollout lineage remains unreleased.

value_zh.html: WebGym 任务池 -> 重叠/稳定性/子任务/去重过滤 -> 教师实时浏览器 rollout -> GPT-4.1 成功判定 -> 最短成功 SFT 策展 -> SFT 热启动 -> 当前策略分组实时浏览器 rollout -> 格式与 VLM 评审奖励 -> MM-GRPO 更新。公开记录级谱系对 SFT 轮次与 RL 提示最强；完整主运行在线 rollout 谱系仍未发布。

value.html: Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking for the main OpenWebRL-4B system; an 8B variant is also reported.

value_zh.html: 主 OpenWebRL-4B 系统用 Qwen3-VL-4B-Thinking；也报告了 8B 变体。

value.html: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking generates SFT candidate trajectories; GPT-4.1 labels SFT success and is the default online-RL success judge. OpenWebRL-Judge-8B is distilled from GPT-4.1-labeled online rollouts.

value_zh.html: Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking 生成 SFT 候选轨迹；GPT-4.1 标注 SFT 成功，并是默认在线 RL 成功评审。OpenWebRL-Judge-8B 从 GPT-4.1 标注的在线 rollout 蒸馏得到。

value.html: Live-browser interaction through the OpenWebRL ReAct-style harness. Four independent teacher trajectories are sampled for each filtered SFT seed; online MM-GRPO samples groups of five trajectories per RL task from the current policy.

value_zh.html: 通过 OpenWebRL ReAct 风格 harness 进行实时浏览器交互。每个过滤后的 SFT 种子采样四条独立教师轨迹；在线 MM-GRPO 从当前策略为每个 RL 任务采样五条轨迹一组。

value.html: WebGym-derived PAE-WebVoyager and InSTA-v3 task sources. The default released SFT trajectories use 412 PAE-WebVoyager tasks across 70 websites; the released RL task pool contains 2,198 tasks across the two sources.

value_zh.html: 源自 WebGym 的 PAE-WebVoyager 与 InSTA-v3 任务来源。默认已发布 SFT 轨迹使用跨 70 个网站的 412 个 PAE-WebVoyager 任务；已发布 RL 任务池含两个来源的 2,198 个任务。

value.html: Teacher SFT generation samples four independent trajectories per seed task. Main RL uses trajectory-level dynamic sampling with groups of five and collects until 48 effective groups per iteration; groups with identical rewards are discarded. Paper-bound random seeds and exact model/API revisions are unknown.

value_zh.html: 教师 SFT 生成为每个种子任务采样四条独立轨迹。主 RL 使用五条一组的轨迹级动态采样，并收集至每次迭代 48 个有效组；奖励相同的组被丢弃。论文绑定的随机种子与精确模型/API 修订未知。

value.html: 412 selected successful SFT trajectories represented by 3,085 turn-level examples; approximately 54K online trajectories reported for the main RL training run. The latter were not confirmed as a public rollout corpus.

value_zh.html: 412 条所选成功 SFT 轨迹由 3,085 条轮次级样例表示；主 RL 训练运行报告约 54K 条在线轨迹。后者未被确认为公开 rollout 语料。

value.html: 0.8 for training rollout sampling in Appendix Table 7. Evaluation uses 0.6 for official-score runs and 0.0 for success-rate-without-aborted runs.

value_zh.html: 附录表 7 中训练 rollout 采样为 0.8。评测对官方分数运行使用 0.6，对不含中止的成功率运行使用 0.0。

value.html: SFT retains GPT-4.1-judged successful trajectories under shortest-path and website-cap curation. MM-GRPO loss uses group-relative advantages and excludes identical-reward groups; judge/infrastructure failures may be zero-masked. Exact numeric embedding thresholds should be recovered from a paper-bound source/config manifest.

value_zh.html: SFT 在最短路径与每网站上限策展下保留经 GPT-4.1 判定成功的轨迹。MM-GRPO 损失使用组相对优势并排除相同奖励组；评审/基础设施失败可被零掩盖。精确数值 embedding 阈值应从论文绑定的来源/配置清单恢复。

value.html: Remove evaluation-overlapping tasks, decomposed subtasks, long-tail or unstable websites, and near-duplicate intents using Qwen3-Embedding-8B similarity. For the default SFT set, keep the shortest successful trajectory per task group, break ties by shorter response length, and cap tasks per website. Exact rejected-record ledger and immutable overlap hashes are unknown.

value_zh.html: 用 Qwen3-Embedding-8B 相似度移除评测重叠任务、分解子任务、长尾或不稳定网站以及近重复意图。对默认 SFT 集，每任务组保留最短成功轨迹，以更短回复长度打破平局，并限制每个网站的任务数。精确被拒绝记录账本与不可变重叠哈希未知。

value.html: Paper training assigns each rollout its own isolated Kubernetes sandbox/browser server to prevent stale cookies, crashes, leaks, and site effects from contaminating other trajectories. Exact browser image, cookie/locale/region/time state and paid Browser-Use session replay parameters for the reported runs are not pinned.

value_zh.html: 论文训练为每个 rollout 分配其隔离的 Kubernetes 沙箱/浏览器服务器，以防止过期 cookie、崩溃、泄漏与站点效应污染其他轨迹。所报告运行的精确浏览器镜像、cookie/locale/region/time 状态以及付费 Browser-Use 会话回放参数未钉扎。

value.html: A 15-step then 30-step rollout curriculum; maximum response length 1,024 and context length 32,768 during RL. The paper reports about 300 B200 GPU-hours, 80-100 concurrent sandboxes, and multiple explicit browser/model/sandbox timeouts.

value_zh.html: 先 15 步再 30 步的 rollout 课程；RL 期间最大回复长度 1,024、上下文长度 32,768。论文报告约 300 B200 GPU-hours、80-100 个并发沙箱，以及多个显式浏览器/模型/沙箱超时。

value.html: Three-epoch LLaMAFactory SFT warm start followed by multimodal multi-turn GRPO on live browser episodes. The reported recipe uses Adam, asymmetric PPO clipping, two PPO epochs, global optimization batch 256, no KL or entropy regularization, SGLang rollouts, Megatron optimization, format gating, and GPT-4.1 or the distilled 8B judge.

value_zh.html: 三 epoch LLaMAFactory SFT 热启动，随后在实时浏览器 episode 上做多模态多轮 GRPO。所报告配方使用 Adam、非对称 PPO 裁剪、两个 PPO epoch、全局优化 batch 256、无 KL 或熵正则化、SGLang rollout、Megatron 优化、格式门控，以及 GPT-4.1 或蒸馏的 8B 评审。

value.html: WebGym-derived tasks, 412 success-filtered PAE-WebVoyager SFT trajectories, a 2,198-record RL-task release, live current-policy rollouts, deterministic format checks, GPT-4.1 judgments, distilled judge data/weights, and three live-web evaluation benchmarks. The 2,102-task parquet is the repository's default RL launcher input.

value_zh.html: 源自 WebGym 的任务、412 条成功过滤的 PAE-WebVoyager SFT 轨迹、2,198 条记录的 RL 任务发布、实时当前策略 rollout、确定性格式检查、GPT-4.1 判定、蒸馏评审数据/权重，以及三个实时网络评测基准。2,102 任务 parquet 是仓库默认 RL 启动器输入。

value.html: SFT Trajectories exposes one train split with 3,085 turn rows from 412 tasks. RL Tasks exposes one train split with 2,198 specifications, while code defaults to a 2,102-task filtered parquet and includes a separate WebVoyager validation parquet. Judge-13K exposes train and 500-example test files. A unified paper-bound split manifest across upstream tasks, SFT selection, RL tasks and all evaluations is unknown.

value_zh.html: SFT Trajectories 暴露一个含来自 412 个任务的 3,085 条轮次行的 train 划分。RL Tasks 暴露一个含 2,198 条规格的 train 划分，而代码默认使用 2,102 任务过滤 parquet，并包含单独的 WebVoyager validation parquet。Judge-13K 暴露 train 与 500 例 test 文件。跨越上游任务、SFT 选择、RL 任务与全部评测的统一论文绑定划分清单未知。

value.html: SFT and RL tasks derive from WebGym/PAE-WebVoyager/InSTA-v3, while evaluation uses WebVoyager, Online-Mind2Web, and DeepShop. The authors explicitly filter evaluation overlap, but public prompts and mutable live sites still create semantic and temporal overlap risks that are not fully enumerated.

value_zh.html: SFT 与 RL 任务源自 WebGym/PAE-WebVoyager/InSTA-v3，而评测使用 WebVoyager、Online-Mind2Web 与 DeepShop。作者显式过滤评测重叠，但公开提示与可变实时站点仍造成未被完全枚举的语义与时间重叠风险。

value.html: The paper reports removing evaluation-overlapping tasks and embedding-based near-duplicate intents before SFT/RL construction. No immutable task-level overlap report, exact benchmark snapshots, rejected-record ledger, or base-model pretraining exposure audit was confirmed, so decontamination remains partial.

value_zh.html: 论文报告在 SFT/RL 构造前移除评测重叠任务与基于 embedding 的近重复意图。未确认不可变任务级重叠报告、精确基准快照、被拒绝记录账本或基座模型预训练暴露审计，因此去污染仍为部分。

value.html: The public SFT release contains only successful completed trajectories: all 3,085 turn rows have reward 1 and represent 412 successful tasks. Training generates both successful and unsuccessful online rollouts, but identical-reward groups are dropped and infrastructure/judge failures can be loss-masked; the approximately 54K rollout corpus was not confirmed public. Judge-13K has train/test files, but its success/failure balance is undisclosed. The paper's 100 manually categorized failed evaluation traces are reported only in aggregate.

value_zh.html: 公开 SFT 发布仅含成功完成的轨迹：全部 3,085 条轮次行奖励为 1，代表 412 个成功任务。训练同时生成成功与不成功的在线 rollout，但相同奖励组被丢弃，基础设施/评审失败可被损失掩盖；约 54K 条 rollout 语料未被确认公开。Judge-13K 有 train/test 文件，但其成功/失败平衡未披露。论文中 100 条人工分类的失败评测轨迹仅以合计报告。

items: Live-site drift, loading errors, access restrictions, CAPTCHA/bot blocking, redirects, personalization, cookies and region can change observations, completion and replay.

The judge is fallible and vulnerable to reward hacking: the base-VLM judge showed high training reward with collapsing evaluation; even the distilled judge is measured primarily by agreement with GPT-4.1 rather than independent human truth.
Format/status gating and zero-masking mean malformed, aborted and infrastructure-failed rollouts do not provide a uniform negative-example contract; full retention is unavailable.
Public SFT supervision is success-only and turn-level, so it omits failed recovery paths and can obscure trajectory boundaries if rows are used without metadata grouping.
The public 2,198 RL task JSONL differs from the 2,102-task default training parquet; exact paper-run membership requires a pinned manifest.
Official evaluation depends on a paid Stealth Browser service and benchmark-recommended judges; success excluding aborted tasks is a different metric and may inflate comparability.
No self-hosted website snapshots or complete environment-state capsules support exact deterministic replay of live-web trajectories.
Judge/model licenses and site/screenshot rights are incomplete, while privacy review is advisory rather than demonstrated by a systematic audit.
实时站点漂移、加载错误、访问限制、CAPTCHA/机器人拦截、重定向、个性化、cookie 与地区可改变观察、完成与回放。
评审会出错且易受奖励劫持：基座 VLM 评审显示高训练奖励而评测崩溃；即使蒸馏评审也主要按与 GPT-4.1 的一致性衡量，而非独立人类真值。
格式/状态门控与零掩盖意味着格式畸形、中止与基础设施失败的 rollout 不提供统一的负例契约；完整保留不可得。
公开 SFT 监督仅为成功且为轮次级，因此省略失败恢复路径，并且若使用行时无元数据分组，可能模糊轨迹边界。
公开 2,198 条 RL 任务 JSONL 与 2,102 任务默认训练 parquet 不同；精确论文运行归属需要钉扎清单。
官方评测依赖付费 Stealth Browser 服务与基准推荐评审；排除中止任务的成功是不同指标，可能夸大可比性。
没有自托管网站快照或完整环境状态胶囊支持实时网络轨迹的精确确定性回放。
评审/模型许可与站点/截图权利不完整，而隐私审查是建议性的，而非由系统审计所证明。

value.html: Dataset cards say private user data is not intended. SFT records nevertheless include screenshots, URLs, message histories and model responses from live sites, and users are told to review them for privacy/copyright/security concerns. No systematic PII detection, redaction, consent, copyright, data-subject or takedown audit is disclosed.

value_zh.html: 数据集卡片称不意图包含私人用户数据。尽管如此，SFT 记录仍包含来自实时站点的截图、URL、消息历史与模型回复，并告知用户审查其隐私/版权/安全问题。未披露系统的 PII 检测、遮盖、同意、版权、数据主体或下架审计。

value.html: The official code repository, SFT Trajectories dataset card, and RL Tasks dataset card specify Apache-2.0. The Judge-13K API exposes no dataset card/license, and the individual released model APIs expose no model-card/license metadata; their rights are therefore unknown rather than assumed from the code license. Website content, screenshots, benchmark sources, and third-party service terms may carry separate rights.

value_zh.html: 官方代码仓库、SFT Trajectories 数据集卡片与 RL Tasks 数据集卡片指定 Apache-2.0。Judge-13K API 不暴露数据集卡片/许可，各已发布模型 API 不暴露模型卡片/许可元数据；其权利因此未知，而非从代码许可假定。网站内容、截图、基准来源与第三方服务条款可能带有单独权利。

value.html: The paper provides the high-level construction chain and public SFT/RL task fields, but does not publish a complete immutable mapping from 292K source records through every filter, teacher attempt, success/failure, selected SFT trace, online RL rollout, reward call, optimizer step, and final checkpoint.

value_zh.html: 论文提供高层构造链与公开 SFT/RL 任务字段，但不发布从 292K 条来源记录经过每一过滤器、教师尝试、成功/失败、所选 SFT 轨迹、在线 RL rollout、奖励调用、优化器步与最终 checkpoint 的完整不可变映射。

value_zh.html: 已对照 arXiv:2606.02031v2、渲染的 37 页 PDF、官方项目页、官方仓库/代码/API、官方 SFT/RL 任务数据集卡片以及评审数据与权重的 Hugging Face API 记录核验。身份与核心配方较强；复用信心因未发布的在线 rollout、可变网络回放、部分去污染、不完整的模型/评审权利以及隐私/审计缺口而降低。

value.html: Appendix G identifies abusive scraping, bot-detection circumvention, inauthentic accounts/engagement, long-horizon errors in purchases or forms, and traffic imposed on third-party sites. Reported mitigations are research-oriented task distributions, rate limiting, bounded released model scale, documentation, ToS/legal compliance, and downstream human confirmation or domain restriction. These are guidance rather than an enforced safety layer in the released agent.

value_zh.html: 附录 G 识别滥用抓取、绕过机器人检测、不真实账户/互动、购买或表单中的长视野错误，以及施加于第三方站点的流量。所报告缓解为研究导向的任务分布、速率限制、有界已发布模型规模、文档、ToS/法律合规，以及下游人工确认或域名限制。这些是指导，而非已发布智能体中的强制安全层。
